schema.title: Response List Projects Api Projects Get

post.description: Upload a video and create a project on it. Files that aren't a readable video get 400.

get.description: The project, its video's facts, and whether the video has been analysed.
The source video as uploaded. Supports HTTP Range, so a ``<video>`` element can seek.

post.description:
Plan a chat request, run the plan, and reply. 409 if the project is already handling one.

``applied`` means every op of the plan is in the timeline. A step the toolbox refuses gives
``not_applied`` and writes nothing.

get.description: The chat so far, oldest first, so a reload restores the conversation.

schema.title: Response Get Messages Api Projects  Project Id  Messages Get

get.description: The project's timeline state, folded from its op log.

post.description:
The video's transcript with word timestamps (F-31), from the cache or made now.

Making one runs Whisper and can take a while; the project is busy (409) until it's done.
503 when the server can't transcribe (stub backend with no cached transcript, or no model).

get.description: The requests in the op log, and whether undo and redo have something to act on.

post.description: Undo the latest request in effect. 400 if there is nothing to undo.
Bring back the most recently undone request. 400 if there is nothing to redo.

get.description: Where the targets are over time, for drawing boxes over the preview.
The stretches of the masks a person should check (F-41), most serious first.

post.description:
Confirm one review item or cut it out, as a hand edit, and return the new queue.

404 if the item is no longer in the queue (someone else's edit changed it); 400 if the
toolbox refuses.

Make sure the video has a vision analysis (F-10). 503 when this server can't provide one.

For now this only replays the shared cache: no detector is connected to the API yet, on any
backend, so a video nobody analysed gets 503 rather than an empty result.

Render the timeline into a new MP4 in the project's ``exports/``. 422 with the reason
when the timeline has an edit the renderer can't apply yet, or cuts that leave nothing.

get.description: The shapes already cached for the masked targets (none if nothing was segmented yet).

post.description:
Segment the masked targets that have no shape yet (``VIBE_SEGMENTER``), then reply like
``GET``. 503 when this server has no segmenter or it can't run: the preview and the export
keep the boxes. Doesn't hold the project, so chatting goes on while it runs.

get.description: One rendered MP4, by the name ``POST .../exports`` returned.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.description: How many tracks GET .../tracks now returns.

end.title: End
end.description: Null means until the end of the video.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: One past chat request with its reply, as stored in the project's ``chat.jsonl``.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Ops written for this request carry this id.

status.title: Status
status.description: applied: the plan ran and its ops are in the timeline. clarify: the reply is a question; nothing was written. not_applied: a tool refused, so nothing was written; the reply says why.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: Shown to the user in the chat.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The tool calls that ran, in order, up to and including one that failed.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Grow the box by this fraction of its size.

Effect.title: Effect
Effect.description: How to hide a visual target. The renderer owns what each setting looks like.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Length of the output in seconds.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: What the renderer masked more because of (a lost track, a missing one).

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: The kind of each op the request wrote, in log order.

text.title: Text
text.description: The chat message, if it was a chat request.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Every request that wrote edits, in log order. Undo and redo aren't listed: they show as the status of the request they acted on.

box.title: Box
box.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2], normalized to 0..1 of the frame width and height.

end.title: End
end.description: Null means until the end of the video.

end.title: End
end.description: Null means until the end of the video.

analysed.title: Analysed
analysed.description: Whether a vision analysis of the video is cached and usable. Until it is, requests that hide people, faces or plates are refused.

action.title: Action
action.description: confirm: mark the stretch as checked. cut: cut the stretch out of the video.

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: Stable for the same track, kind and range, so a client can keep its place.

label.title: Label
label.description: The track's label (``face``, ...), or null if no track has this id.

op_id.title: Op Id
op_id.description: The mask op whose span this stretch is in.

analysed.title: Analysed
analysed.description: Whether the video has an analysis. Without one, masks on analysed targets show as no_track: the whole frame is hidden until the video is analysed.

items.title: Items
items.description: The stretches of the masks to check, most serious first.

held_seconds.title: Held Seconds
held_seconds.description: Time in held stretches (a box kept just past a track's end) not yet reviewed.

rules_not_audited.title: Rules Not Audited
rules_not_audited.description: Standing rules, which can't be audited ahead of a render.

except_identities.title: Except Identities
except_identities.description: Enrolled identity ids that stay visible.

Rule.title: Rule
Rule.description:
A standing rule, evaluated on every frame against whatever the detectors find.

"Only I am visible" is ``category="person", except_identities=["id_me"]``. Fail closed:
a detection whose identity is unknown or unsure is **not** excepted, so it gets masked.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: Same field names as F-09's ``SpeechSegment``; ``speaker`` comes with F-32.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.description: By track id, in time order: the shape of each masked target at its keyframes, for the preview to clip its effect to (F-15). Tracks with no cached shape aren't listed: the preview keeps their box.

end.title: End
end.description: Null means until the end of the video.

args.title: Args
args.description: The arguments, with every $ref filled in.

result.title: Result
result.description: What the tool returned, as compact JSON. Null if it failed.

StepReport.title: StepReport
StepReport.description: One tool call as it ran.

start.title: Start
start.description: Seconds from the start of the source video.

end.title: End
end.description: Seconds, excluded. Null means until the end of the video.

TimeRange.title: TimeRange
TimeRange.description:
A span of **source** time in seconds, start included, end excluded.

``end`` is ``None`` for "until the end of the video". Times always refer to the original
video, so a cut never shifts other edits (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, "The contract").

masks.title: Masks
masks.description: Per track id: when it's masked and how.

reviewed.title: Reviewed
reviewed.description: Per track id: the source-time spans a person confirmed (F-41 review queue). May cover time with no mask, so consumers intersect it with `masks`.

cuts.title: Cuts
cuts.description: Source time ranges removed from the output, merged.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Matched enrolled identity, if any (for rules).

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.description: The cached analysis's tracks, then the project's hand-drawn ones.
